name: Hellfire Forgemaster raises block value by 30% and converts fierce blows to blocks (#833)
contract: Hellfire Forgemaster 560655 reads 'Increases your block value by $s1%. Additionally, you have a X% increased chance to block fierce blows.' Effect 0 is native aura 150 (SPELL_AURA_MOD_SHIELD_BLOCKVALUE_PCT), EffectBasePoints 29 with DieSides 1 -> 30 (verified in the installed Spell.dbc: EffectApplyAuraName[0]=150, EffectBasePoints[0]=29, EffectDieSides[0]=1). Its handler AuraEffect::HandleShieldBlockValuePercent (src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuraEffects.cpp:215,5232) multiplies GetTotalAuraMultiplier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_SHIELD_BLOCKVALUE_PCT) into the shield's block value -- a fully native, generic stat aura; no script is required for this clause. The fierce-blow clause is a dedicated local hook, not a stub: src/server/game/Entities/Unit/Unit.cpp:3232-3236, inside Unit::RollMeleeOutcomeAgainst's crushing-blow branch, reads 'if (Player const* knight = victim->ToPlayer(); knight && knight->getClass() == 17 && knight->HasAura(560655) && knight->CanBlock() && knight->GetShield(true) && victim->HasInArc(float(M_PI), this) && roll_chance_i(60)) return MELEE_HIT_BLOCK;' immediately before the native 'return MELEE_HIT_CRUSHING;' -- both clauses are delivered, one by a native generic aura, one by a class-17-gated script hook; nothing was missing. HARNESS LIMIT: the fierce-blow clause only fires inside RollMeleeOutcomeAgainst's crushing-blow branch, which requires a live melee attacker 4+ levels above the Knight with a 15+ weapon-skill gap and a frontal roll -- conditions this harness's passive/non-attacking fixtures cannot reliably reproduce, so only the block-value clause is asserted numerically here; the fierce-blow conversion needs a Ghost e2e encounter against a higher-level attacker.
